Offset printing is a traditional and widely used printing technique known for its high quality and efficiency. In offset printing, the image to be printed is first transferred from a plate to a rubber blanket. This is done using a process where the image is etched onto a metal plate, usually made of aluminum. The rubber blanket then transfers the inked image onto the printing surface (usually paper).
